title: Healthy Loaded Ground Beef or Turkey Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef or ground turkey
2 tbsp homemade taco seasoning (chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt)
1/2 cup shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
1/4 cup sliced black olives & 1/4 cup diced red onion
1/2 cup salsa + 1/3 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt (whisked together as creamy salsa dressing)
instructions: Brown the ground beef or turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat for 7–8 minutes, breaking it apart.
Stir in the taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water; simmer 2 minutes until thick and saucy.
Arrange chopped Romaine lettuce in large bowls and top with cherry tomatoes, avocado, shredded cheese, red onion, black olives, and warm seasoned taco meat.
Drizzle with the creamy salsa-yogurt dressing and garnish with cilantro and fresh lime.
